subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Pentaammine(dinitrogen)ruthenium(II)（[Ru(NH₃)₅(N₂)]²⁺）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Trigonal bipyramidal
D. Trigonal planar
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Ru (group 8) 8 e; 1 × N₂ (L) 2 e; 5 × NH₃ (L) 10 e; the 2+ charge removes 2 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex has a 2+ charge, so the metal is Ru(II), d⁶; d⁶ + 12 e from the ligands = 18 e. The first dinitrogen complex (1965).
